scene_description: A woman wearing an apron is cooking at a gas stove, stirring food in a dark pan. Steam is rising from the pan. A basket of vegetables and fruits sits on the counter nearby. Kitchen utensils hang on the wall in the background.

questions.question: Who is in the picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person standing at the stove.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is in the woman's hands.

questions.question: What is in the basket on the counter?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the basket next to the stove.

questions.question: Where is the woman standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is right in front of the woman.

questions.question: What is coming out of the pan?
questions.evidence_hint: Look above the pan on the stove.
